programme.title: Keep It Down
programme.desc: Yijun is a urologist and works alongside gynaecologist Weikang and psychotherapist Zac. They treat patients struggling with intimate conditions. As they heal others, their emotional wounds resurface. Yijun is haunted by the trauma of a flasher; Zac likes mature women who are 20 years older; and Weikang is diagnosed with testicular cancer, they slowly learn that healing begins with themselves. 一君是一名泌尿科医生，与妇科医生伟康及心理治疗师Zac一起，接诊那些有难以启齿的疾病患者。在治愈他人的过程中，他们各自的情感创伤逐渐浮现。一君仍被暴露狂事件的阴影困扰，Zac偏爱年长二十岁的成熟女性，伟康则被诊断出睾丸癌。他们也慢慢明白，真正的疗愈，始于直面自己。

programme.title: Talk of The Town
programme.desc: A half-hour talk-show segment in Hello Singapore which brings together diverse voices and expert opinions to thought-provoking discussions on wide range of issues. Incorporating online polls which gather public opinions, the segment creates a space that allows for multi viewpoints in the studio from Monday to Friday.

programme.title: The Queen of News 2
programme.desc: Man Wai-sum retired from the media six months ago. With a background in marketing management, Kingston Koo is abruptly appointed as director. Deputy Director Cheung Ka-yin takes over Leung King-yan’s status but struggles to gain the respect of her colleagues. Wai-sum makes a strong comeback as the Queen of News, acquiring the online media platform founded by Lau Yim and challenges conventional mainstream media. 文慧心（佘诗曼饰）退隐新闻界半年，SNK生巨变。市场管理出身的古肇华（黄宗泽饰）空降总监一职，视新闻为赚钱工具；副总监张家妍（李施嬅饰）取代了梁景仁（马国明饰）的地位，纵握大权却难服众。慧心以“新闻女王”姿态强势回归，收购刘艳（王敏奕饰）创办的网媒公开平台，向传统主流媒体发起挑战。KOL唐芷瑶（陈晓华饰）利用自媒体，对慧心展开恶意狙击。

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Focus provides timely reports and analyses on international news and current affairs from Singapore's perspective. 《焦点》追踪国际时事，实地报道区域课题，以新加坡的视角分析时局发展的前因后果和潜在影响。

programme.title: 100% Wife
programme.desc: Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

programme.sub-title: Great Ocean Road journey to South Australia with a surprise reunion
programme.desc: Along the Great Ocean Road, the trio marvel at the Twelve Apostles and sunset at Warrnambool, sharing parenting stories as Edwin seeks advice. After visiting an abalone farm, they head to South Australia for a feast and a surprise guest, ending with a picnic at a sinkhole and funny nature mishaps.

programme.title: Journey To Jianghu
programme.sub-title: Episode 12: Guizhou: Ming and Qing Ancient Towns
programme.desc: In Guizhou’s Zhenyuan Ancient Town, the duo explore Ming-Qing history through winding alleys and the legendary Dragon-Slaying Sword of Zhang Sanfeng. At Qinglong Cave, they witness the harmony of Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism before tasting tofu grilled fish by the Wuyang River. In Yelang Valley, decades of stone art reveal mythical carvings, including the four disciples. In Guiyang, Changwang noodles and sizzling barbecue awaits them.

programme.title: The Glory
programme.desc: Abandoned as a child, Zhuang Han Yan grows up in the southern countryside before returning to her family in the capital. She catches the eye of Fu Yun Xi, a deputy minister with a mysterious illness, who sees her as an ideal wife. As they navigate their relationship, they fall in love, and Han Yan reconnects with her mother while finding warmth and belonging with the Fu family.

programme.title: Love of Nirvana
programme.desc: Xiao Wu Xia, the young lord of Yueluo City, has been living in hiding in Liang Kingdom under the alias Wei Zhao, bearing the shame of being labeled a traitor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his family’s downfall and capture the sole survivor of Prince Qi’s case. However, his plans are derailed by the unexpected arrival of Jiang Ci. Pei Yan takes the injured Jiang Ci into his home, aiming to discover who’s behind the disruption.

programme.title: Travel with Parents
programme.desc: Embarking on a magical journey, Axian, Jiang Han and Hui Mei gift their parents with the luxury of companionship, creating unforgettable memories filled with love and romance. 陪伴，是世上最奢侈的礼物。阿贤将联同江瀚和慧敏带着父母去旅行，帮他们完成旅行愿望清单，用父母的速度旅行，双手相握一起看世界，是再多钱也换不到的人生体验，一起踏上奇幻浪漫的旅途。

programme.title: A New Life
programme.desc: Youfu (Christopher Lee) is an average Joe who stopped schooling from a very young age to join the workforce. However, as he is slow-witted and clumsy, many of his employers find his work performance wanting. However, he is optimistic by nature and does not hold a grudge. Following the death of his father, the heavy burden of supporting the whole family falls squarely on his shoulder. This drama depicts how he and his three bosom friends whom he befriended back in his army days, Laifa (Darren Lim), Ah Gen (Hossan Leong) and Steven (Weng Xing'ang), face many difficulties in their life.

programme.title: SG Explorers
programme.desc: We always say that Singapore is so boring! But statistics from Singapore Tourism Board suggested otherwise. Just last year, tourists visiting Singapore has increased from 16.4 million to 17.4 million since 2016! You might be sick of the typical places of interest available in Singapore but hey, there’s more to Singapore than you think. Join our tour as we re-introduce Singapore through unique and strictly no trespassing places! 人们常说，新加坡很boring！然而，新加坡旅游局数据却不是这么说！光是去年，入境我国的旅客人数就从前年的1640万人增加到1740万人。谁说新加坡boring的？！或许你已经厌倦了千篇一律的旅游景点，现在是时候让全民动起来，一起出去走走，寻找鲜为人知、闲人勿扰的景点，以独特的视角，重新认识新加坡！

programme.desc: The owner of My One and Only, Ma Limin, aspires to become a real estate developer with her son Hao Renpin, offering one-stop services for property purchase and renovation with her husband Hao Haojian and interior designer Wan Defu, who run How Luck Renovation. programme.title: Keep It Down
programme.desc: Yijun is a urologist and works alongside gynaecologist Weikang and psychotherapist Zac. They treat patients struggling with intimate conditions. As they heal others, their emotional wounds resurface. Yijun is haunted by the trauma of a flasher; Zac likes mature women who are 20 years older; and Weikang is diagnosed with testicular cancer, they slowly learn that healing begins with themselves. 一君是一名泌尿科医生，与妇科医生伟康及心理治疗师Zac一起，接诊那些有难以启齿的疾病患者。在治愈他人的过程中，他们各自的情感创伤逐渐浮现。一君仍被暴露狂事件的阴影困扰，Zac偏爱年长二十岁的成熟女性，伟康则被诊断出睾丸癌。他们也慢慢明白，真正的疗愈，始于直面自己。

programme.sub-title: Is there a risk of death when taking long-haul flights?
programme.desc: Can long-haul flights pose life-threatening health risks? This episode examines potential dangers associated with prolonged air travel and offers practical precautions. Medical experts also discuss cervical disc problems, their causes and symptoms, and ways to protect the neck and spine.

programme.title: The Glory
programme.desc: Abandoned as a child, Zhuang Han Yan grows up in the southern countryside before returning to her family in the capital. She catches the eye of Fu Yun Xi, a deputy minister with a mysterious illness, who sees her as an ideal wife. As they navigate their relationship, they fall in love, and Han Yan reconnects with her mother while finding warmth and belonging with the Fu family.

programme.title: Love of Nirvana
programme.desc: Xiao Wu Xia, the young lord of Yueluo City, has been living in hiding in Liang Kingdom under the alias Wei Zhao, bearing the shame of being labeled a traitor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his family’s downfall and capture the sole survivor of Prince Qi’s case. However, his plans are derailed by the unexpected arrival of Jiang Ci. Pei Yan takes the injured Jiang Ci into his home, aiming to discover who’s behind the disruption.

programme.title: Hong Kong: A Feast of Local Flavours
programme.desc: The five hosts will lead the audience into farmland and fish rafts to see the development of Hong Kong's agriculture and fisheries. The program will also start from local ingredients and look for high-quality ingredients that are truly from Hong Kong or made in Hong Kong, in order to support a group of industry friends who stick to the original taste and help revitalize the local economy.

programme.title: A New Life
programme.desc: Youfu (Christopher Lee) is an average Joe who stopped schooling from a very young age to join the workforce. However, as he is slow-witted and clumsy, many of his employers find his work performance wanting. However, he is optimistic by nature and does not hold a grudge. Following the death of his father, the heavy burden of supporting the whole family falls squarely on his shoulder. This drama depicts how he and his three bosom friends whom he befriended back in his army days, Laifa (Darren Lim), Ah Gen (Hossan Leong) and Steven (Weng Xing'ang), face many difficulties in their life.

programme.title: Salt of the Earth
programme.sub-title: This Salt Made From Mountains, Not The Sea?
programme.desc: Salt is one of humanity's oldest creations, an invisible force that has shaped trade, rituals and civilisation itself. This documentary series journeys across the Philippines and Japan archipelagos to uncover rare and vasnishing salt-making traditions where land, sea, fire and time converge. Each episode follows a salt artisan whose craft holds patience, intuition and deep local knowledge; from earthenware salt that is forged by fire, to seaweed-infused minerals once offered to emperors. Continued by makers who stand as quiet acts of resistance, each story explores how taste becomes history, how labour becomes sacred ritual, and how something as small as a grain of salt can carry the weight of place, culture and ancestral memory.

programme.title: Beating The Heat
programme.sub-title: No Escape From the Heat: How Communities Are Adapting
programme.desc: Across Asia, extreme heat is reshaping everyday life, changing how people learn, work and rest. Beating the Heat follows communities and experts testing practical ways to protect homes, schools and neighbourhoods as temperatures rise. The first episode explores local responses, from early-warning systems and cooler public spaces to urban farms and buildings designed for shade and airflow. Each story begins with lived experience and asks whether one solution can grow beyond a single pilot or community. The second widens the lens from households and neighbourhoods to city- and national-level action. Across classrooms, homes and urban landscapes, it examines how clean energy, passive cooling, green spaces and new technology can protect people without adding to the emissions heating the planet. As the region warms, can cities adapt without leaving their most vulnerable residents behind?

From artificial intelligence to blockchain, drones to data-driven machine-learning, this documentary uncovers how visionary companies and organisations are leveraging cutting-edge tools with human ingenuity to create impactful climate solutions. These new and innovative technologies are not just reshaping industries, they are also a critical ally in our fight to save our earth.
